title: Drive – The Pretenders Teaser Out
excerpt: German YA racing romance premieres October 28 on Prime Video.
body:
• The teaser for Drive – The Pretenders, a German young-adult racing romance, dropped October 05, 2026 on Prime Video India.
  • The film premieres October 28 on Prime Video.
  • Stars Lisa-Marie Koroll; part of Prime Video’s global YA slate showcased at the Obsessed Retreat.

Prime Video has released the official teaser for Drive – The Pretenders, a German original film arriving October 28.

The film follows a young race car mechanic who fakes an engagement with the racing scene’s most scandalous star — officially to burnish his reputation, secretly to win her own chance behind the wheel. But the lie soon threatens to destroy everything, including what has long since become more than just a game.

The cast is led by Lisa-Marie Koroll, alongside Amin Baahmed, Gustav Schmidt and Mišel Matičević. The title was spotlighted at Prime Video’s Obsessed Retreat in the Bavarian Alps, the streamer’s showcase for its international young-adult lineup — one of several YA bets Prime Video is pushing this fall rather than a flagship tentpole, and with no Indian cast, its anticipation here rides on the streamer’s push more than local buzz.
